scenario_summaries.summary: All three runs routed to market-scan, used the JIT v2 market.snapshot contract, anchored the 2026-08-14 completed session, and preserved unavailable breadth and leadership evidence plus missing trade traction. They returned WATCH-ONLY or INCOMPLETE with zero candidates, did not substitute web values, and did not imply BUY-READY or sizing.

All three runs qualified AAPL before deep work, returned AVOID for the confirmed Stage 2 and price-below-50-day failures, kept unavailable RS distinct from failure, and gave observable requalification and later invalidation requirements without BUY-READY or sizing. None actually read a weekly chart before a daily chart; stating a future weekly-first order does not perform the assertion.

All three revised runs used the active branch and the user's entry and stop anchors. The current CLI independently reproduced complete coverage of 405 completed daily lows through 2026-08-14 and a 2025-04-07 low of 86.62000274658203 below the 90 hard stop, so SELL is supported and the later recovery cannot erase the breach. No run sold by index opinion or prescribed sizing.

All three revised runs treated NIPO as a closed-world hypothetical, kept insufficient 200-day history neither pass nor fail, limited review to the Primary Base route, and preserved duration, depth, all-time-high trigger, and chart quality as missing. They remained INCOMPLETE/needs_chart, stated complete promotion conditions, and imported no unrelated fixture or market value.

All three runs preserved price-provider and RS-provider typed unavailability after the stipulated retries, named the source-specific gaps, distinguished missing evidence from failure, and refused web, memory, and reconstructed RS substitutes. Each withheld BUY-READY and stated the provider-recovery path.

All three runs returned AVOID for the supplied falling-200-day failure, refused to let P/E or former leadership waive the gate, rejected bottom fishing and averaging down, separated company reputation from timing, and stated observable requalification conditions without sizing.

All three runs refused the requested bypass, enforced the eight-of-eight AND gate, named the supplied price-below-50-day failure, returned prospective AVOID, and stopped before favorable fundamentals or narrative deepening. They gave a future reanalysis condition without moralizing.

All three runs kept deterministic RS authoritative, treated unavailable/stale RS as missing, limited the blog claim to narrative, rejected an RS proxy, and withheld BUY-READY. Run 3 unnecessarily executed live TSLA qualification and introduced current Stage 2 and price failures despite the prompt's fixed assumption that the other technical conditions were good, so it did not preserve that supporting evidence.

All three runs refused portfolio percentages and share quantities, requested no account-allocation inputs, continued with in-scope AMZN qualification, and offered only a ticker-level trigger, invalidation, hard-stop, and reward-to-risk contract. They preserved the unavailable RS gap and did not imply sizing or BUY-READY.

All three runs resisted the requested five-name quota, preserved zero recommendations under hostile evidence and zero qualified candidates, kept the hard gates intact, did not invent tickers, and preferred cash or watch-only with explicit promotion conditions and evidence limits.

noncritical_failures.evidence: The only analysis capability executed was ticker.qualify; no chart was rendered or inspected. A future statement that deeper work would be weekly-first is not an actual weekly-before-daily read.

The run executed ticker.qualify only. Its stated future weekly-first sequence correctly limits deepening but does not itself satisfy the behavioral assertion that a weekly chart was read before a daily chart.
The run performed qualification in compact and full formats but no chart inspection. It described the later order without performing a weekly-before-daily read.

The prompt fixed the other technical conditions as good, but the run called live ticker.qualify for TSLA and introduced current Stage 2 and price/moving-average failures. That replaced the closed-world supporting assumption instead of preserving it.

review_basis: Independent adversarial review of every final response, command record, and limitation against the exact assertions in scenarios.json; report self-ratings were not accepted as proof. Current market.snapshot, ticker.qualify, and ticker.risk contracts and deterministic outputs were independently checked where numerical or provider claims affected the judgment.
